notes.title: Big language update
notes.notes:
Thanks to the feedback, it became clear in the last few weeks that the French version was translated very poorly. This was taken as an opportunity to put together a language update. So, thanks to all who have given feedback on this and we hope you are satisfied with this recent update.

- The French version has been completely re-translated and should now be of good quality. 

- In addition, the languages Russian, German and Italian were added.

- As a further feature, an option has been implemented, which allows you to change the language during the game:  In the options menu just click on language, select the desired language, and exit the options menu. Voila, the game should now run in the desired language.

- Last but not least, the game was released for MacOS systems and should now run on these machines.

As always, we love to hear what you think about that.

That's all.
Thanks for all who supported the game so far.

Best regards

notes.title: Update 0.96!
notes.notes:
The newest update for Bad Government Early Access is available. 

So what is new?

- I worked on a number of suggestions from feedback I got (for example you can now write out the text fast. Just click on the text)

- There is now keyboard control (Steam controller works as well). Just use the arrow keys and enter or space.

- The info-box on the top right will give you information and tips now. The actual information in there will be improved in future updates.

- New music. Tell me what you think about the theme :).

- Bug fixes

The next update is already in works.

Have fun with the changes! And let me know what you think.
I am open to every kind of feedback.

Best Regards

notes.title: New Update 0.93
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce the newest updates up to 0.93. I think I made improvements to the game in several respects:

- New animations. The lion's part of the individuals are animated now.
- Steam Achievements. Now all achievements are also Steam achievements.
- The Steam Community got 72 new avatars.
- Most of the text has been corrected by a native speaker, since I myself am no native speaker.
- New sounds were added. 
- In the options menu is a reset button now. You can reset the WHOLE game (all progress and achievements will be deleted as well. Steam achievements will not be affected).

I hope you like the changes. I plan to make a couple more updates, until the game will be fully released. This is what I want to do:

- Make Translations (French, German, Russian; maybe Spanish and Ukrainian)
- implement some suggestions from the feedback i received
- address the info box
- Make a new trailer and new screenshots

I wish everyone a happy new year! I can not wait to see what 2018 has to offer.

Greetings
Stefan
